subject: Eesha Kapoor — competing offer; request to bridge + geo uplift
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-12T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Eesha Kapoor — competing offer; request to bridge + geo uplift

Team — quick heads up: Eesha Kapoor (candidate for Sr. ML Platform Eng) just received a competing offer from a stealth infra startup. They have an expiration of 07/18 EOD. Rachael (recruiter) forwarded the competing packet this morning.

Why this matters: Eesha is our top candidate for the role and has expressed a clear preference for Redwood, but the competing offer has a higher cash component and a faster decision window. We risk losing momentum if we don't respond with something tangible this week.

Asks:
- Can we approve a bridge offer (one-time sign-on) of up to $12,000 USD?
- Can we approve a temporary geo uplift to bring total OTE within ~5% of the competing cash-heavy offer (estimated by Rachael; see comp_band_jul2028.pdf attached)?
- If approved, I can route a near-final offer (draft attached) and request an extension with Eesha until 07/21 while we finalize DocuSign.

Attachments: comp_band_jul2028.pdf (comp band table), offer_draft_v2.pdf (draft with placeholder equity)

I recommend moving fast — if we want the uplift, we should lock manager + HR signoff today so I can communicate a concrete number.

— Vivek
VP, Engineering Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eesha Kapoor — competing offer; request to bridge + geo uplift

Vivek — thanks for flagging. A few quick clarifying Qs before I approve anything:
- Total target comp range you're aiming for (base + sign-on + equity annualized)?
- Is the hiring manager comfortable with a 1x sign-on and a tweaked equity grant, or do they want a base increase?
- Do we have capacity in the current comp band or will this require an exception?

Jonas — if you can weigh in on manager appetite that helps. If we can keep this to a one-time cash sign-on + small equity uplift (no base change), I'm inclined to approve fast. We should confirm budget and get HR legal to sign-off on the contract wording.

Laura
Sr. Director, Talent
From: Eesha Kapoor <eesha.kapoor@gmail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-12T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eesha Kapoor — competing offer; request to bridge + geo uplift

Hi Vivek — thanks for the update and for advocating. I wanted to be transparent: I did receive a competing offer with an acceptance deadline of 07/18. I remain very interested in Redwood; culture and the team are the main reasons. A few things that would make the decision easier for me:

- $10k–$15k one-time sign-on (to match gap in first-year cash)
- Slight uplift in equity (2% additional RSU that vests on the same schedule) or a front-loaded portion if possible
- Ability to start remotely for the first two weeks (relocation later)

If you can share a committed timeline by tomorrow or provide an extension until 07/21, that would help a lot. Appreciate the transparency.

Best,
Eesha
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-13T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eesha Kapoor — competing offer; request to bridge + geo uplift

Looping in my note: manager (hiring team) is strongly in favor of Eesha — technical fit + immediate impact. I reviewed the numbers with the hiring manager:

Proposed quick plan (manager approved):
- One-time sign-on: $10,000 USD (payable within 30 days of start)
- Equity: +2% RSU one-time uplift (kept within discretionary band for this role)
- No base increase — keep base per band to avoid setting precedent
- Remote-first start for two weeks: approved

I attached offer_draft_v2.pdf with the sign-on and uplift populated. Please confirm HR/legal can approve the language and that total comp still fits within headcount/grant budgets. If HR needs a JIRA/expense code I can provide it (JIRA-HR-3456).

If HR approves today, Vivek — can you ask Rachael to request an extension from Eesha until 07/21 to give us time for DocuSign?

— Jonas
Director, Engineering
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-14T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eesha Kapoor — competing offer; request to bridge + geo uplift

Thanks for the clear plan. HR has reviewed the numbers and can approve the one-time sign-on of $10,000 USD and a discretionary +2% RSU uplift for this hire. Conditions:
- Sign-on to be paid as a separate bonus line item on first payroll run after start date.
- RSU uplift to be granted as a separate tranche with the same vesting schedule as the original grant.
- Legal will need to review the final offer wording; I will push the draft to Legal for same-day review.

Next steps I need from hiring:
1) Finalized offer PDF (with exact figures and start date) — attach to this thread.
2) Confirmation of budget/JIRA code (JIRA-HR-3456 is noted; please confirm).
3) Recruiter to request extension with candidate to 07/21.

If we get those today, Legal has agreed to a 24-hour turnaround.

Neha Kapoor
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Eesha Kapoor <eesha.kapoor@gmail.com>, Rachael Singh <rachael@talentpartners.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-15T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final: offer confirmation + DocuSign link / extension request

Hi Eesha — great news. We were able to approve a one-time $10,000 sign-on and a +2% RSU discretionary uplift. The manager and HR have signed off with the following conditions: sign-on paid on first payroll, RSU uplift as a separate tranche with identical vesting, and no base change.

Action items for Rachael:
- Please request an extension with Eesha to 07/21 so Legal and DocuSign flow can complete.
- Once extension is secured, I will send the DocuSign link below.

DocuSign (placeholder link): https://docusign.example/offer/XYZ-123

Eesha — if you can confirm you still want us to proceed under these terms, we will send the final offer and move to signature today. Looking forward to having you on the team.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: offer_draft_v2.pdf
